card.name: Monitoring advice and 'if appropriate' hedges
card.fires_on: The comma or 'if' in 'and, if appropriate, initiate...' or 'If appropriate,' after a monitoring instruction in warnings. Also some word endings inside monitoring-related terms like anaphylaxis, sedation, hypotension.

modes.label: If appropriate hedge
modes.description: The 'if' or comma in a conditional 'if appropriate' clause that comes before starting treatment.
modes.example: Closely monitor hepatic function in these patients and,<< if>> appropriate, initiate anti-HBV treatment [

modes.label: Comma after condition
modes.description: A comma after an 'If ... occurs' or 'If appropriate' clause, before the action to take.
modes.example: If a hypoglycemic reaction occurs<<,>> moxifloxacin hydrochloride

modes.label: Inside adverse-event terms
modes.description: Middle or end of a reaction term named in a monitoring instruction.
modes.example: evaluate patients for respiratory depression and sed<<ation>> at frequent intervals.

card.plain: It fires in warning text that tells the reader to monitor a patient and then act if appropriate.
